title: Rolling Statistics
instructions: Create a monthly GDP time series with trend and noise. Compute 3-month and 12-month rolling means using pandas. Print the last 5 rows showing both rolling means alongside the original values.

import pandas as pd

np.random.seed(7)
dates = pd.date_range('2015-01', periods=60, freq='MS')
gdp = 100 + np.arange(60) * 0.5 + np.random.normal(0, 2, 60)
